collab-remote.description: Grants the 'collab' window -- which loads a colleague's third-party page -- the single command its injected scraper needs to hand results back. Tauri refuses app commands from remote origins unless a capability with a matching `remote.urls` entry grants them, so this is scoped to exactly one command and one origin. receive_scraped_text additionally rejects callers whose window label isn't 'collab' (see main.rs), and every sensitive command is guarded by require_main_window, so this grant cannot widen into file or API-key access.

default.description: Permissions for the main window. Because build.rs declares an app ACL manifest, every app-defined command the main window invokes must be listed here explicitly -- omitting one fails at runtime with 'Command X not allowed by ACL'. receive_scraped_text is deliberately absent: only the collab window ever calls it.
